loading_policy: Load only the exact path and inclusive line range for the active module. Never read all level banks or the full curriculum by default.
module_boundary_policy: A grammar module is an indivisible top-level learning unit. Its internal topics may be handled separately only at complete conceptual boundaries; never stop mid-explanation, example sequence, comparison, or comprehension check.

modules.title: Főnevek, nem, szám és névelők
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: articles, noun gender and number, plural forms, and noun phrases are visible. These are observed examples, not an explicit grammar heading.

modules.title: Személyes névmások és jelen idejű igeragozás
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: present-tense forms across persons, including ser, querer, vivir, regular verbs, tener, ir and others. The conjugation system is observed, not explicitly named as a Guidebook target.

modules.title: Ser, estar és hay
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: ser, estar and hay occur in identification, origin, state, location and existence contexts. These are observed examples.

modules.title: Melléknevek, birtokosok és mutató szavak
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: possessives, demonstratives and adjective agreement in gender and number are visible. These are observed examples.

modules.title: Kedvelés, mennyiség és étkezés
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: food, quantities and prices occur in requests and shopping; gustar/interesar/encantar structures appear in section 2. These are observed examples, not a complete grammar syllabus.

modules.title: Napi rutin és gyakoriság
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook section 2, user-supplied examples: frequency expressions and reflexive daily-routine verbs occur. These are observed examples.

modules.title: Hely, irány, felszólítás és közeli jövő
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: place expressions, estar/hay location questions, directions, destinations and transport expressions occur. These are observed examples.

modules.title: Tagadás és egyszerű mondatkapcsolás
modules.evidence_note: Guidebook sections 1–2, user-supplied examples: negation and basic connectors such as pero and porque occur in context. These are observed examples.

evidence_policy: duolingo_grammar_evidence records the strength of a grammar-to-unit link: explicit (named in public course data), observed (seen in an actual unit example but not named as a target), inferred (probable from theme/reference), reference_only (CEFR/reference mapping only), or unknown. It is separate from learner mastery.
mastery_policy: Learner grammar mastery is tracked only in the per-course state card from learning evidence. Never infer or advance mastery from Duolingo unit position.
